output.title: The Countess
output.logline: Framed for a $4.2 million fraud by her best friend on the night of her promotion, a young analyst comes back six years later as the anonymous buyer of the firm.
output.hookPromise: she will take back everything, one betrayer at a time, and we will see what it costs her

source.author: Alexandre Dumas
source.credit: Inspired by The Count of Monte Cristo by Alexandre Dumas
source.engine: betrayed by friends on her happiest day, buried for years, a dying mentor and a hidden fortune, the return as a stranger who owns them all

output.arc: Edie is framed by Fern, Dan and Valerie in six minutes. Six years in cell 34 give her a teacher and eleven million dollars. She buys the firm that destroyed her and walks into its boardroom in the same blazer she was arrested in. The question the season leaves: what will revenge cost her?

episodes.title: Six minutes
episodes.hook: 6:02 pm, her promotion toast: "I'm the youngest VP they've ever had."
beats: Edie toasts her promotion at 6:02 pm.
Fern hands her a red USB stick "from Dan".
At 6:08 Dan brings the police: $4.2 million left under her login.
Valerie finds the email that clears her, sees her father's name and deletes it.
In cuffs, Edie begs Fern to speak.
episodes.openLoop: Valerie deletes the proof: who else knows?

cliffhanger.moment: Fern, close, looking away from Edie
cliffhanger.question: why would her best friend betray her?

episodes.title: Cell 34
episodes.hook: Six years later, cell 34: "Six years, and you still count the bars."
beats: Ivo, dying, asks for her hand.
He writes 24 words on her palm: a wallet nobody knows.
Eleven million dollars, "for a life, not for them".
Her phone: Pharaon Capital is for sale.

cliffhanger.moment: her thumb on the send button
cliffhanger.question: what will she do with the company that destroyed her?

episodes.title: The Countess
episodes.hook: The buyer paid forty million in cash, and nobody knows the name.
beats: Dan, Valerie and Fern wait for the anonymous buyer.
The new owner walks in: Edie, in the same blazer.
She puts the red USB stick on the table.
Valerie: "You got nine years." Edie: "I got out in six."

output.reason: The book's engine kept: three betrayers with three small motives (envy, love, a father), the buried years, the mentor and the treasure, the return as a stranger. Each episode has one place, one piece of evidence and a cliffhanger on its shortest line.
